title: Vanilla Copper Golem Additions
description: Small improvements to the Copper Golem with vanilla-style mechanics, interactions, and behaviors
body:
**Vanilla Copper Golem Additions** is a lightweight Fabric mod that **expands upon the original Copper Golem** while staying true to the vanilla Minecraft aesthetic and mechanics. **No new entities, items, or custom assets—just** pure vanilla-style enhancements implemented cleanly through mixins. The goal is to bring **small improvements** to the Copper Golem functionality while keeping the gameplay and aesthetics completely faithful to Mojang’s design.

# Features ## Bundle Integration The Copper Golem can now be equipped with a bundle that appears on its back! This upgrade allows it to **carry up to 64 items of the same type**, instead of the usual 16 from vanilla. **How to Equip:** Simply right-click the Copper Golem with an empty bundle in your hand to equip it. **How to Unequip:** To remove the bundle, just right-click the golem with shears — it will drop the bundle and return to its normal state. ## Beacon Effects Copper Golems now benefit from **beacon effects**, opening up creative new ways to enhance their abilities and gameplay interactions! #### Jump Boost Support Jump Boost from beacons increases the Copper Golem’s jump height, allowing it to leap higher and reach new places — gaining +1 block of jump height per Jump Boost level. #### Haste Support Haste reduces the time Copper Golems spend searching open chests, making them more efficient helpers! Level 1 slightly increases their speed, while Level 2 and above grant the same maximum search speed. #### Speed Support The Speed effect boosts the Copper Golem’s movement speed, letting it move faster across the world.

# Future Plans - Add a **config file** for greater customization options - Enhance **Copper Golem AI** for smarter behavior - Apply **bundle colors** directly to the golem’s model - **Improve animations** when beacon effects are active - Experiment with item filters for golems - Explore ways for golems to pick up items from the ground - Research methods to highlight accessible chests
